 Position Summary 
 As part of a centralized Employee Relations (ER) Center of Excellence, this role serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders, HR Business Partners, Global Employment Law (GEL), and cross-functional stakeholders on complex employee relations matters. The position is responsible for independently leading workplace investigations, performance and conduct management cases, and employee risk mitigation efforts while ensuring compliance with employment laws, company policies, and organizational values. 
 The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in employee relations investigations, performance management, stakeholder consultation, and labor law compliance within a multinational environment. This individual must be comfortable navigating sensitive and high-risk situations, influencing senior leaders, and balancing employee, legal, and business considerations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Employee Relations & Investigations 
 Lead end-to-end employee relations investigations from intake through fact-finding, interviews, evidence analysis, findings, recommendations, and case closure. 
 Handle complex and sensitive matters, including harassment, discrimination, retaliation, workplace misconduct, conflicts of interest, ethics concerns, and policy violations. 
 Conduct independent investigations and prepare clear, objective, and well-documented investigation reports and recommendations. 
 Partner closely with Global Employment Law, Ethics & Compliance, Security, and HR stakeholders on high-risk or escalated employee matters. 
 Assess legal, reputational, operational, and employee-related risks and provide recommendations to support informed decision-making. 
 Performance & Conduct Management 
 Serve as a subject matter expert on employee performance, conduct, disciplinary actions, and involuntary separations. 
 Advise and coach managers on difficult employee situations, including performance improvement plans (PIPs), misconduct investigations, corrective actions, and terminations. 
 Ensure consistent and legally compliant application of policies and employment practices across employee populations. 
 Support leaders in managing complex performance and behavior-related concerns while balancing business objectives and employee experience. 
 Consultation, Partnership & Coaching 
 Act as a trusted advisor to HRBPs and business leaders on employee relations strategy, risk management, and workplace conflict resolution. 
 Influence and coach leaders at all organizational levels through complex and sensitive employee situations. 
 Partner effectively with HR Centers of Excellence, Legal, Compliance, Security, and regional HR teams to drive consistent employee relations practices. 
 Foster productive relationships across diverse cultures and stakeholder groups within a matrixed global organization. 
 Global Collaboration & Compliance 
 Support employee relations matters involving regional and global stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. 
 Interpret and apply employment laws, regulations, and company policies to ensure compliant business practices. 
 Prepare professional reports, business communications, and case summaries for regional and global leadership audiences. 
 Monitor external labor and employment trends and recommend proactive risk mitigation strategies. 
 Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement 
 Track and analyze ER case metrics, trends, root causes, and organizational risks. 
 Identify opportunities to improve employee relations processes, policies, governance, and manager effectiveness. 
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance investigation quality, case management, and employee experience. 
 Training & Enablement 
 Develop and deliver training programs for managers, HR teams, and stakeholders on employee relations, investigations, performance management, and workplace conduct. 
 Build organizational capability in managing employee issues proactively and consistently. 
 Partner with GEL and HR stakeholders to enhance ER-related tools, resources, and manager readiness. 
 Skills & Competencies 
 Advanced workplace investigation and fact-finding skills. 
 Strong expertise in employee relations, performance management, and conduct management. 
 Exceptional consulting, influencing, stakeholder management, and coaching capabilities. 
 Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to balance legal, employee, and business risks. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare investigation reports and executive-level recommendations. 
 Ability to manage highly sensitive and confidential matters with discretion and professionalism. 
 Executive presence with the ability to influence leaders in complex and ambiguous situations. 
 Collaborative, culturally agile, and effective in multinational and matrixed environments. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify patterns, root causes, and organizational risks. 
 Demonstrated learning agility, resilience, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

 Experience working in a multinational corporation or complex matrix organization.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment.  Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification

 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
